expanded_targeted_oracle.metric_note: win count is exact over all screened schedules because only prior-loss rows can add wins; margin statistics are conservative because added routes were not run on prior-win rows

limitations: The 160 rows were already unblinded and are development data, so all oracle and LOFO numbers are diagnostic rather than untouched-holdout evidence.
The route oracle chooses after seeing each route final margin and is an unattainable upper bound, not a deployable policy.
Frozen replay continuation evaluates response to recorded opponent actions; it is not live Kaggle proof against adaptive counterplay.
Feature correlations and ridge importance are associations in this development set, not causal guarantees.
Additional experts were evaluated only on the residual loss rows from the preceding stage, so this is a targeted win-ceiling screen rather than a full margin-ranking matrix.
Expert choice remains hindsight oracle information; the observable LOFO selector evidence does not demonstrate that these routes can be selected reliably live.
The zero-gain fourth stage is the bounded stop condition; the unscreened population was not exhaustively brute-forced.
